name: second-reader
description: Truth-grounded literary criticism — an MCP server plus a long-form essay workflow. The bundled MCP server exposes eleven lit_* tools (corpus search, citation verification, claims lookup and graph, PDF ingestion, source procurement, annotation, bibliography export, and full-output verification) against a pgvector corpus. Five skills (setup-second-reader, start-essay, build-reading-list, procure-sources, verify-draft) and the lit-research agent drive a long-form critical essay end to end against the corpus.
